summary:
Castle: long red-terracotta range (y0..9, corbel table, dark slate gables) with nine towers: crenellated square North Tower over an arched porch and oriel, the Flag Tower beside it rising to y19, an east octagonal tower, and slate spires on the west pair, wings and south octagonal pair.
Arts and Industries: a brick Greek cross in a square with yellow and blue bands, four gabled entrance naves with twin towers and an octagonal rotunda with drum and lantern. Freer: a low white-terracotta palazzo round a court, with a three-arch north loggia and a grey hip roof.
Hirshhorn: a beige drum (y3..10) on four curved piers with a dark glass band round the court and one balcony slot facing north. Silhouette, colour and these signature features are what make each one readable from the air. Four-plot South Mall kit built from the architect's masses. The Castle's nine-tower jagged slate silhouette (Flag Tower tallest) is the hero, with the polychrome Arts & Industries cross, the low Freer palazzo and the raised Hirshhorn drum beside it. Exterior only: hollow interiors, shroomlight glow behind glass, lanterns and uplights at the bases.
elements: castle roofs, towers' caps and lights (parts/castle-roofs.mjs)

summary: castle shell: Castle shell built in parts/castle-shell.mjs: main block, ranges, wings, apse, porch, oriel, all nine tower shafts, and the pinnacles. It also has the corbels, string courses, quoins, and glazed windows and slits with glow cells. make.sh gives a whole build.nbt with 5476 blocks placed and no refused or off-palette lines.
polish: Granite flecking in the wall courses was not done (the flecks helper is unused; the walls are plain red_terracotta apart from the quoins).
Main-block upper windows are 3 high (y5..7), not the 4 in the plan, so the hoods clear the y9 corbels.
No window glow cells for the tower slits.
The porch roof slab is at z1 only, because the oriel's corbel stairs take z2 at y4.
Tower tops are open above the shaft tops (T1 y14, T3 y14, T2 y17), so P2 must add the T1 deck at y15, the parapets and the spires.
T1's interior is carved to y14 and the octagon interiors are carved, so P2 can't write into those cells.
Not done: a render check of the north front close-up, and the `$MCD fit` run.

waste.cost: about 40 lines, plus one gableEnd box-format retry
waste.tool: A `replace` option on archedWindow and slitWindow that cuts the wall first; a `hollowMass(box, top)` helper (solid, plinth, carved inside, slab floor).

waste.what: Worked out by hand which hood, sill and corbel cells collide on shared faces (y3, y4, y9).
waste.cost: several minutes of cell-by-cell reasoning
waste.tool: A facade layout checker that lists proud-trim collisions before building.

companions.task: Granite fleck runs and the quoin rhythm along every face.
Glass and glow cells for the tower slits and the oriel.

summary:
A&I shell: P3 A&I shell is built in parts/ai-shell.mjs: brick body ring with yellow bands and polished andesite plinth, four corner pavilions, N-S and E-W naves with gable walls to y15, octagonal rotunda (y1..10) and drum (y11..14) on a brick ceiling, eight entrance towers, four gables with diamonds, big arched windows and glass doors, body and clerestory windows.
make.sh runs clean: A&I shell placed 3341 blocks with 0 refused and 0 off-palette. mcd check reports 0 floating blocks and mcd fit is OK. The zoomed north entrance reads as the Arts & Industries gable.
P3 is ticked in plan.md and the Plot 1 items it covers are ticked in elements.md.
polish: P4 roofs and caps: pavilion pyramids y8..10 with finials, the nave gable roofs, the quadrant hips at y7, the rotunda skirt at y11, the drum cap, the 2x2 tower caps and finials, and the lantern box x80..82 z19..21.
P4 lights and verges: lamps either side of each door at y3, shroomlight glow behind the big arches and every third body window, and the stone_brick verges on the gables.
Tower corner quoins are not built (only the pavilion corners have them). The red_terracotta course at y8 under the clerestory sills is also missing.
The big arches have an orange top course only; the orange voussoir stairs at the top corners are not built. The body windows are rectangular openings with an orange hood, not stair arches.
Footings at y0 under the SE corner (ground-map zeros) are not built; the grass at y0 supports the walls, so nothing floats there.
Body windows moved to x67/70/73 and x89/92/95 because x64 and x98 would cut the corner pavilions. Plan.md Notes records this.
Glass pane connection states are set by hand (along the wall) and only checked by eye in one zoom render.

companions.task: Lay the SE-corner footings at y0 where the ground map is 0, and the tower quoins alternating 2 and 1 high at every tower and pavilion corner.
Glaze the big arches with the orange voussoir stair corners, set the glass panes with correct connection states, and place the door glazing and the nave clerestory joints.
Lay the nave gable roofs, the quadrant hips, the rotunda skirt and drum cap, and the pavilion and tower caps in stone-brick stairs and slabs, verges included.

summary:
A&I roofs and lights: parts/ai-roofs.mjs builds the A&I roofs and lights: nave gables (eave y11, one union call with the crossing kept clear), four quadrant hips (y7), rotunda skirt (y11) and octagon-approximating drum pyramid (y15..18), the 2x2 entrance-tower and 5x5 pavilion caps with finials, the lantern box x80..82 z19..21 y19..22 on a stone-brick pad, glow cells behind the big arches and body windows, and eight door lanterns.
Roofs are laid with roof() calls inside build(), not roof.json, so runParts skips its roof step. make.sh saves a whole build.nbt; the A&I roofs part reports 2454 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
Verified by zoom render from the south: the gables, hips, pyramid and lantern read as grey stone-brick roofs. Floating-block and unsupported-lantern warnings remain in my copy only because the A&I shell (P3) is still a stub.
polish: Lamps and grounds for plot 1 are not built: no lawn or path lamp posts, no uplights, no grounds around the building (not in elements.md, but the brief lists 'surrounding grounds').
Roofs and lantern float in this copy until the A&I shell (P3) puts walls under them; the 2454-block float count is the stub, not a fault in P4.

Door lanterns at (79|83,3,0), (79|83,3,41), (61|101,3,18|22) stand on jamb blocks at y2 that P3 must keep solid, and their cells must stay air; runParts will refuse them if P3 fills those cells, so the lanterns will be missing from the merged build until P3 leaves them open.
Glow cells (81,7,1), (81,7,40), (62,7,20), (100,7,20) and the body-window glows at x64/73/95 z3,38 and x63/99 z6,28 must match P3's window and wall positions; not yet checked against P3.
The 1-in-4 andesite mix is dropped: the roof tool wrote full andesite blocks at valleys (off-palette), so the slate is plain stone_bricks with stone_brick_stairs and slabs.
The rotunda skirt is a rectangular hip over x74..88 z13..27, not an octagon; the drum pyramid is an octagon approximated by a union of three rects.

summary:
Freer palazzo: Freer palazzo (P5) built in parts/freer.mjs: 170-wide ring of white terracotta round an open court at x107..135 z2..25, three-arch diorite loggia on the north front, 1x1 windows, glass door, cornice, two-tier andesite hip roof, court with fountain, four oak trees, lamps and paving.
make.sh saved a whole build.nbt: Freer placed 2652 blocks, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; check reports 0 floating blocks in the Freer plot.
Zoomed north and south renders read as a low palazzo with a central loggia; plan.md P5 ticked and the Plot 2 elements.md items ticked with the deviations noted.
polish: Roof is not the roof tool: no roof.json from this part, so the hip is hand-stepped (andesite_slab eave, polished_andesite core, andesite_slab top tier). No andesite_stairs hip edge, no overhang, no `$MCD roof --style hip`.
Court paving has no grass squares (plan lists them under the court).
Court edge has no proud slab into the court; the court walls are capped with polished_diorite at y5 instead.
Lawn and terrace have no lamps of their own, only the loggia lanterns and four court posts; plan lighting says every lawn cell lies within 7 of a lamp, which Freer does not yet meet.

Court x117..125 (plan SITE table) differs from the footprint map, which shows the court at x118..125 with walls at x117 and x126. I followed plan.md; the trees (118 and 124) and fountain (121) are symmetric about 121, so that holds.
Sill and lintel of the 1x1 windows at y0 are set into the plinth course (diorite replaces smooth stone there), so the lowest windows have no separate sill.

waste.what: Clearing the grass ground layer by hand under the whole plot so the air-only helpers (loggia, cornice, courtTree, fountain, lampPost) would write; then restoring grass cell by cell for the unbuilt rest.
waste.cost: about 3 full-plot fill and scan passes, one failed assumption that the helpers would overwrite ground
waste.tool: A helper option such as over:true (or a 'clear ground under footprint, restore grass outside' call) on loggia, cornice, courtTree, fountain and lampPost, as ashlarWall already has.

waste.what: Writing each 1x1 window by hand (pane with join state, diorite sill and lintel set into the wall) because smallWindow only writes into air and has no sill-replace option.
waste.cost: about 60 window calls across the four faces and court faces, computed cell by cell
waste.tool: smallWindow with opts.over: true and a row-of-windows helper (faces, starting offset, step, heights) that takes a list of cells.

waste.what: Hand-stepping a two-tier low hip roof with slab and full-block layers, computing each cell's inset from the outer ring by arithmetic.
waste.cost: three layered loops and an inset check, about 1 retry on the stacking of bottom slabs over top slabs
waste.tool: `$MCD roof` with style hip and maxHeight 1 applied to the ring footprint from a roof.json the part can write (slateRoof spec plus a per-part roof call), so the part does not need its own roof code.

waste.what: Checking a plot's windows, lamps and grounds by reading the zoom PNGs one at a time, with no per-element count against the Openings table.
waste.cost: 2 zoom renders plus a check run
waste.tool: A `$MCD openings build.nbt --plot 2` (or a checklist mode for elements.md) that reports every opening and light listed in the plan as present or missing.

companions.task: Lay the low Freer hip in true andesite stairs and slabs with proper hip corners and a 0.5 pitch, rather than my stepped two-tier approximation.
Fit the 1x1 windows and the glass door with the correct pane joins and any frames, then confirm the court-face windows at y3 line up with the y1 ones.
Lay the court's grass squares among the smooth stone paving and add the lawn lamps at the terrace and north lawn so every lawn cell is within 7 of a light.
Check the loggia's diorite arch stairs and the piers' joints against the frieze, and cut the proud court-edge slab the plan asks for.

summary: Hirshhorn drum: ["P6 Hirshhorn built in parts/hirshhorn.mjs: raised precast drum (y3..9, 2-wide strips, y10 deck and coping), four curved piers, soffit froglights, balcony band and north slot, court fountain, plaza paving with light-grey rings, low walls with gaps, sculptures, lamp posts, deck lanterns.", "make.sh gives a whole build.nbt. polish: Light is not measured by the tool: mcd light only reports named rooms, so the plaza and court have no dark-cell count. My estimate is that every plaza and court cell gets light from the lamps, uplights, deck lanterns and soffit froglights, but this is unverified.

Plaza lamp posts use two polished_blackstone blocks under a lantern, not polished_blackstone_wall as plan.md's lampPost note says, because that wall block is not in palette.json. Add it to the palette if the wall look is wanted.
The piers are hard to make out in the zoom render at this scale; they may need a closer look in the hero view.
The whole-kit render shows no problem in plot 3. The Castle's shroomlight orphans in check come from P1, not this part.
